name: NICE Information Service Co., Ltd.
summary: NICE Information Service Co., Ltd. provides personal and corporate credit information, credit scoring, credit evaluation, identity verification, debt collection, credit investigation, and credit information management services in South Korea. The company also offers credit management and consulting services, data analytics, data-driven advertising services, business valuation and valuation consulting services, lending and receivables purchase and collection services, and treasury stock trust services. It serves financial institutions, corporations, public institutions, and individual customers. NICE Information Service Co., Ltd. was founded in 1985 and is headquartered in Seoul, South Korea.
